title: Orbit and Terminal
author: Rosalind Quintana
blurb: Noor Thackeray, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
